send_intents.subject: Versioned brand context at Rainbrand
send_intents.body:
Hi Ray,

Rainbrand's idea of versioned brand context callable through MCP is interesting because agents shouldn't reconstruct identity from scattered assets on every run. Your founding engineer role covers ingestion, retrieval, evaluations, and developer APIs, not just generated creative.

I built Captor, a TypeScript SDK that enforces per-call LLM budgets and tool policies, records traces, and detects loops. I've also owned production backend APIs and React features end to end. I'd enjoy helping make Rainbrand's shared context dependable across agent workflows.

I'm based in India and open to relocating; your role offers visa support. Could I show you Captor?

Devansh
https://devansh.aurat.ai
https://github.com/8dazo
